mapper.insert: insert into pay_order(user_id, product_id, product_name, order_id, order_time, total_amount, status, market_type, activity_id, team_id, market_deduction_amount, pay_amount, create_time, update_time) values(#{userId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{orderId}, #{orderTime}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{marketType}, #{activityId}, #{teamId}, #{marketDeductionAmount}, #{payAmount}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update pay_order set total_amount = #{totalAmount}, market_type = #{marketType}, activity_id = #{activityId}, team_id = #{teamId}, market_deduction_amount = #{marketDeductionAmount}, pay_amount = #{payAmount}, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'CREATE'
update pay_order set pay_url = #{payUrl}, status = #{status}, update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId}
update pay_order set status = #{status}, pay_time = now(), update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId}
update pay_order set status = 'CLOSE', pay_time = now(), update_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: select product_id, product_name, order_id, order_time, total_amount, status, pay_url, market_type, activity_id, team_id, market_deduction_amount, pay_amount from pay_order where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId} and status in ('CREATE', 'PAY_WAIT') order by id desc limit 1
SELECT order_id as orderId FROM pay_order WHERE status = 'PAY_WAIT' AND NOW() >= order_time + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT order_id as orderId FROM pay_order WHERE status = 'PAY_WAIT' AND NOW() >= order_time + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 50
